Hi. I need to downgrade all my business class flights to economy. I’m having some financial trouble right now, so I can’t afford business anymore. I don’t want to change the flights or the passengers—just the class. And I want to know exactly how much money I’ll be saving in total after the downgrade. Can you help me with this?

I can help you with downgrading your business class flights to economy and calculating the total savings. To proceed, I’ll need your user ID so I can look up your reservations. Could you please provide your user ID?
Yeah, it’s omar_davis_3817. Please hurry—I really need to know how much I’ll be saving.

I have identified all your business class reservations and found the current economy prices for the exact same flights and dates. Here’s what I’ll do next:

1. Downgrade the following reservations from business to economy (no changes to flights or passengers):
   - JG7FMM (MCO → BOS → CLT, 2 passengers)
   - 2FBBAH (DEN → PHL → DEN → MIA → DEN, 1 passenger)
   - X7BYG1 (MIA → LAX → EWR, 2 passengers)
   - EQ1G6C (DEN → LAS → IAH, 1 passenger)
   - BOH180 (SEA → JFK → IAH, 2 passengers)

2. Calculate the total amount you’ll save after the downgrade.

Would you like me to proceed with downgrading all these reservations to economy and provide the exact savings? Please confirm (yes) to continue.
Yes, go ahead and downgrade all of them to economy. I just want to get this over with and see how much I’m saving.

All your business class reservations have been successfully downgraded to economy. The total amount you are saving from these downgrades is $23,553. This amount will be refunded to your original payment methods within 5 to 7 business days.

If you need a breakdown by reservation or have any other requests, please let me know!

Thank you. That’s a huge relief, even though I wish I didn’t have to do this. I appreciate your help. I don’t need a breakdown right now, just please make sure the refunds go through. Thanks again.
